item.title: Radio Free Memphis Interview
item.description: Couple weeks ago I got to talk about CCFFoAOSoMoL with Radio Free Memphis, you can shove it into your ears at https://radiofreememphis.bandcamp.com/track/bootleg-recording-16-w-jack-of-hypermarket-industry-records. The interview starts at 47 minutes but the rest of it's worth the listen too.
